title: JavaScript
description: Complete JavaScript final interview preparation, from language fundamentals to advanced internals.

categories.title: 01. Fundamentals
categories.description: Variables, data types, coercion, operators and control flow.

categories.title: 02. Execution & Scope
categories.description: Execution contexts, call stack, hoisting, lexical scope and closures.

categories.title: 03. Functions
categories.description: Function declarations, expressions, this, callbacks and higher-order functions.

categories.title: 04. Objects & Prototypes
categories.description: Object creation, properties, copying and prototypal inheritance.

categories.title: 05. Classes & OOP
categories.description: Constructors, classes, inheritance, encapsulation and polymorphism.

categories.title: 06. Arrays & Collections
categories.description: Array methods, Map, Set, WeakMap, WeakSet and typed arrays.

categories.title: 07. Asynchronous JavaScript
categories.description: Callbacks, promises, async/await, concurrency and the event loop.

categories.title: 08. Iterators & Generators
categories.description: Iteration protocols, generators and asynchronous iteration.

categories.title: 09. Modules
categories.description: ES modules, CommonJS, imports, exports and dynamic loading.

categories.title: 10. DOM & Events
categories.description: DOM manipulation, event propagation and event delegation.

categories.title: 11. Browser APIs
categories.description: Storage, HTTP, Fetch API, workers and browser rendering.

categories.title: 12. Memory Management
categories.description: Memory allocation, garbage collection, reachability and memory leaks.

categories.title: 13. Functional Programming
categories.description: Pure functions, immutability, composition and functional patterns.

categories.title: 14. Error Handling & Debugging
categories.description: Error types, exception handling, custom errors and debugging.

categories.title: 15. Performance & Optimization
categories.description: Complexity, debounce, throttle, memoization and optimization.

categories.title: 16. Advanced JavaScript
categories.description: Proxy, Reflect, Symbols, design patterns and advanced internals.
